name: Beyond Curry: Indian Mackerel Fry

cookwares.name: frying pan and bowl for marinating

instructions.primary_message: Gut the mackerel, keep it whole and make 2 or 3 diagonal slits along it's length on both sides.
Mix ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, lime juice/vinegar and salt in a bowl.
Apply the marinade to the fish, making sure that it gets into the slits. Allow it marinate for 8 to 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan till shimmering. Slide in the marinated mackerel and fry on a medium flame for about 4 minutes on each side till golden brown, taking care not to break the skin while flipping.
Serve hot with a sprinkle of lime.

schema_metadata.keywords: bangda, Beyond Curry, fish, fried fish, mackerel, seafood

description: Basic Indian fried fish is very simple to make and totally delicious. There are variations from region to region, but one I personally enjoy is this simple Bangda (mackerel) Fry. It employs just five ingredients and gives great results each time. Even if you don't have to haggle with the fishmonger.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Lime wedges for garnishing

Optional substitutions: lime juice → ½ tbsp vinegar
author: Denise D'silva Sankhé
